label: rem:blowup-regularity-as-lifting
title: Regularity as lifting through the obstruction tower
html:
Regularity as lifting. The q-NS solution v_q(t) is smooth for q > 1. The exponential damping of high modes ensures v_q has exponentially decaying Fourier coefficients. All obstruction classes vanish:

  |\hat{v}_k(t)| \leq |\hat{v}_k(0)|e^{-\nu_q[k]_q^2 t}
  \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
  \kappa_n(v_q(t)) = 0 \quad \forall n.

The decay rate \nu_q [k]_q^2 \sim \varepsilon\, q^{2k} exceeds any polynomial. The field v_q lifts through the tower to all levels.
